topic: The Mystery of Pi: Definition and Historical Evolution

sections.title: The Hook: The Constant Ratio
lecture_lines: Circles have a secret, constant ratio.
animations: Draw a circle using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/wheel.svg] with radius r = 1.0 (Color: #FFFFFF). Label 'r' and 'd' near the circle.
Animate the circumference C unfolding into a linear segment along the bottom of the screen. Label 'C' (Color: #00FF00).
Display the formula ratio C / d = π in the center (Row B) using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/wheel.svg] as a visual reference. Highlight 'π' (Color: #FFFF00).

sections.title: Defining Pi: The Mathematical Formalism
lecture_lines: Pi is circumference divided by diameter.
Big or small, the ratio stays constant.
Pi is an endless, irrational number.
animations: Position formula C = πd centrally in Row B (Color: #FF00FF). Label 'C', 'π', and 'd'. Use [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/ruler.svg] to represent the measurement of diameter 'd'.

Create a scaling animation showing 'd' increasing while the ratio 'π' remains fixed (Color: #00FFFF). Label current diameter and fixed 'π'. Use [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/tape.svg] to illustrate the expanding circumference.

Highlight the constant value 'π' with a glowing pulse effect to emphasize its invariance, accompanied by the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/protractor.svg] to represent the geometric relationship.

sections.title: Historical Evolution: The Method of Exhaustion
lecture_lines: Archimedes squeezed the circle with polygons.
More sides get closer to the circle.
This trapped the value of Pi.
animations: Draw a circle and a starting square polygon inside (Color: #FFFFFF, #00FF00). Label 'Circle' and 'Square'.
Iteratively transform the polygon into a hexagon, then octagon, etc., getting closer to the circle (Sequential Transform).
Display numerical labels for the perimeter of the polygon (Color: #00FF00) as it approaches the circumference of the circle.

sections.title: Modern Perspectives and Wrap-up
lecture_lines: It helps your phone navigate routes.
Pi bridges geometry and the infinite.
animations: Display a stylized icon of a GPS satellite [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/satellite.svg] and a smartphone [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/smartphone.svg]. Label 'GPS' and 'Nav'.
Animate digits of 'π' cascading from top to bottom behind the devices (Color: #FFFF00).

Fade the central devices [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/satellite.svg] and [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/smartphone.svg] and digits out to black, leaving only the label 'π' in the center.
